name: codex-orchestra
description: Local control plane for Codex Router, logical team roles and managed project files.

interface.shortDescription: Configure Router, team roles and managed Codex files from a local plugin.
interface.longDescription: Codex Orchestra is a Windows-first local control plane. The plugin exposes redacted health, Router lifecycle, catalog status, logical team bindings, managed AGENTS.md writes, diagnostics and worktree planning through skills and a local stdio MCP. The desktop app remains the advanced UI. Thread create/send/steer is delegated to the existing codex-control plugin. Secrets never leave Router helpers or OS stores.
